description: A refined, spa-inspired bathroom vanity vignette with a warm California aesthetic. The vanity counter is white Carrara or Calacatta marble with subtle grey veining, housing an undermount rectangular sink. The faucet set is in a warm brushed brass or antique brass finish with cross-handle details. Resting on the counter surface are a small woven rattan tray holding neatly rolled white hand towels, a glass pump-top liquid bottle in amber tone, and a small potted herb or succulent in a white ceramic pot. The vanity cabinet below the counter is a creamy painted white with visible drawer hardware in the same warm brass. The background wall is smooth plaster in warm cream or greige. A large round mirror with a thin brass frame is centered above the sink. On either side of the mirror, round globe-like forms in frosted alabaster or cloudy white glass with brass canopy fittings emit a warm diffused glow that washes symmetrically across the plaster wall. Natural light enters from a window to the left, laying a bright diagonal across the wall surface. Camera at standing eye-level, centered symmetrical composition focused on the vanity mirror and counter, normal lens, level pitch, tight vignette on the vanity wall.
